symptom: v29 passed candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget without warnings, playable coverage audit, GameCore validate-content, and the standard 300s / 10-seed all-Bot matrix for seeds 70000-70009. A separate 300s / 3-seed probe for seeds 71000-71002 still returned repair: CowardBot and RouteBot were too successful at 66.7% against the low-skill 10%-35% target, KiteBot was too stable at 100.0% against the high-skill 45%-75% target, and BossHunterBot was too weak at 0.0% against the high-skill 45%-75% target. The standard 10-seed pass suggests this is a seed-window robustness concern rather than a broad content regression.
root_cause: The v27-v29 content repairs improved playable coverage and static budget hygiene. The standard 70000-70009 expansion shows the main Frosting Grassland 300s balance band is currently acceptable, but the 71000-71002 probe exposes high variance around the 210-300s Boss-after pressure window. Small exploratory probes showed that globally buffing Candy Crystal Lance overcorrects BossHunterBot and that simply softening the 210-225s wave can raise other Bot win rates, so the remaining issue needs seed-window robustness analysis rather than immediate broad tuning.
fix: Do not promote v29 into accepted_content or Runtime content, and do not claim final acceptance. Keep v29 as a generated candidate with strong standard-matrix evidence, then run an additional 71000-71009 all-Bot expansion or a targeted v30 probe before any simulated/playtest candidate promotion. If the 71000 expansion remains outside target, prefer narrow 225-300s pressure and route-safety changes over global weapon buffs, broad XP changes, or Boss nerfs.
validation: Completed partial candidate validation, materialization, full-pack preflight, static balance budget, playable coverage audit, GameCore validate-content, 300s / 3-seed all-Bot matrix on 71000-71002, and standard 300s / 10-seed all-Bot matrix on 70000-70009. Next validation should run 71000-71009 expansion or a focused v30 repair. A viable next gate should keep Coward and Route between 10%-35%, Greedy / Tank / ZoneControl between 25%-55%, Kite / BossHunter between 45%-75%, and Idle / Random inside their floor bands before Replay regression, design review, manual playtest, or acceptance can be claimed.
